records.rationale: The diff does flip the behavioral expectation in `PasskeysOrganizationAuthenticationTest.passwordLoginWithNonDiscoverableKey`: it changes from asserting the WebAuthn form is absent (`Assert.assertThrows(NoSuchElementException.class, () -> driver.findElement(By.xpath("//form[@id='webauth']")))`) to asserting it is present (`MatcherAssert.assertThat(driver.findElement(By.xpath("//form[@id='webauth']")), Matchers.notNullValue());`) both right after username selection and again after error/correct login. This aligns with code changes that preserve/setup passkeys UI during username/password errors

records.issue_text: [ADVISORY] AuthenticatorUtils.java:127: Boolean.parseBoolean(userAlreadySetBeforeUsernamePasswordAuth) parses the raw auth note; any note value other than exact string 'true' (e.g. 'TRUE', '1', or user-controlled values from custom flows) silently yields false, causing the re-auth form to fall back to regular username+password layout with registration link shown and no error or log — custom authenticators writing USER_SET_BEFORE_USERNAME_PASSWORD_AUTH with non-canonical values (invited by the constant being made public in this diff) get a half-broken re-auth page
records.rationale: In AuthenticatorUtils.setupReauthenticationInUsernamePasswordFormError the code reads a raw auth note string and gates the re-auth UI behavior on `Boolean.parseBoolean(userAlreadySetBeforeUsernamePasswordAuth)`.
